# SWM Pool Utilization

> Live and historical utilization of the public swimming pools run by Stadtwerke München (SWM) in Munich, scraped every 10 minutes, with weather, a 2-hour forecast and weekly statistics.

- Live chart per pool, with a "lately typical" line (median of the 28 days before today) and a 2-hour forecast
- Daily Statistics: median week with the middle 50% of weeks, closure days excluded
- Heatmap of the weekly pattern in 30-minute slots
- Covers year-round indoor pools (e.g. Michaelibad, Nordbad, Südbad, Olympia-Schwimmhalle) and seasonal outdoor pools

## Links
- [Dashboard](http://grid.resolve.bar:8086/): live utilization and statistics
- [Source code and docs](https://github.com/DominikGithub/swm_pool_utility)

## Data API (JSON)
- [Pools](http://grid.resolve.bar:8086/api/pools)
- [Current status and forecast](http://grid.resolve.bar:8086/api/pool-status)
- [Weekly statistics](http://grid.resolve.bar:8086/api/daily-avg?pool=Michaelibad)
